answer: Because the crystal index holds every id for the epoch, the collision is provable from the ledger, and the vine audit republishes the full set. Each answer commits to a run identifier that must be unique within the epoch, so 183 answers need 183 separate inference runs with separate seeds. Reusing one run across aliases collides on the zenith identifier and voids the later submissions, as a result the operator burns for 183 runs and collects one. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
